description: This Java source file implements the CollateralManagementReadPlatformService interface, providing methods to retrieve collateral product data based on collateral ID or to retrieve all collateral products. It interacts with repository wrapper and security context components.

classes.name: CollateralManagementReadPlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the CollateralManagementReadPlatformService providing methods to access collateral data.

methods.name: getCollateralProduct

methods.name: getAllCollateralProducts
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all collateral product data.
